latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Create a Video with AI" skill.
- Upload images (JPG, PNG) or video/audio files (MP4, MOV, etc.; up to 500MB) and describe your desired output.
- Automatically generates 1080p MP4 videos from your assets in 1-2 minutes, with support for editing instructions, text overlays, transitions, and audio tracks.
- Simple setup: auto-acquire tokens, manage sessions, and connect to the cloud rendering API with minimal user effort.
- Supports core workflows: uploads, exports, credit checking, previewing tracks, and session management.
- Built for marketers and content creators wanting quick, no-edit AI video generation from their existing materials.
